title: Fin array cell with periodic sides
pickerTitle: Fin array cell with periodic sides
line: A steady thermal FEA study of one cell of a straight-fin heat sink, with periodic side faces.
description: Steady temperature of one 10 mm pitch cell of a straight-fin aluminum heat sink: a 5 mm base and one 2 mm fin, 30 mm tall and 50 mm deep. The base takes 5 kW/m^2 (2.5 W per cell) and the fin and exposed base lose heat to 25 C air at 25 W/m^2/K. The cell side faces are tied by a periodic constraint, so the cell stands for the whole array.
thumbnailAlt: Temperature in one cell of a finned heat sink with periodic sides, solved in RunMat
